redemption.pay_with_points_note: PayPal 'Pay with Rewards' for eligible purchases; also redeem for past purchases

point_valuation.cpp_note: Fixed 1.0 cpp across all redemption methods via Wells Fargo portal. Transfer partners may yield higher value depending on the booking.

wells_fargo_travel_portal.note: Fixed value — flights, hotels, car rentals booked through Wells Fargo Rewards portal. No minimum redemption amount.

statement_credit_travel.note: Redeem as statement credit to cover previous travel purchases at the same 1.0 cpp rate.

transfer_to_partners.note: 1:1 transfer ratio to airline and hotel partners. Value depends on how you redeem with the partner — can exceed 1.0 cpp for the right bookings.

point_valuation.best_practice: For everyday use, book through the Wells Fargo travel portal for a straightforward 1.0 cpp. For higher value, transfer to Air France/KLM Flying Blue or British Airways Avios — both allow booking partner airlines (e.g., Alaska, American) at potentially better rates.
